facts.text: TEMClient sends a netstring-encoded JSON-RPC request over socket.create_connection and raises RuntimeError when the server reply carries an error
TEMClient.set_stage sends stage_positions and relative to the server
TEMClient.acquire_image reconstructs the (list, shape, dtype) tuple the server returns into a numpy array
TEMClient.get_vacuum and TEMClient.get_microscope_status are plain RPC calls
TEMServer initializes the detectors flu_camera, ceta_camera, scan and super_x
TEMServer constructs auto_script.TemMicroscopeClient and connects it to 127.0.0.1:9095
TEMServer.get_stage returns five float coordinates read from specimen.stage.position; b is 0 for a SingleTilt holder
TEMServer.set_stage writes the x, y, z, a and b directions into a StagePosition and calls relative_move_safe or absolute_move_safe
TEMServer.acquire_image calls microscope.acquisition.acquire_camera_image and returns serialize(image.data), a list with its shape and dtype
TEMServer.acquire_spectrum returns a 2048-sample float32 zero array
TEMServer.get_vacuum returns 1e-5 and TEMServer.get_microscope_status returns 'Idle'; the code states no unit for the vacuum number
TEMServer.close prints a message and returns 1; it does not command the electron beam or the stage
The server main listens on 0.0.0.0 port 9093

operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the travel range or the unit of the five stage coordinates (x, y, z, a, b); the holder and the AutoScript configuration set them, so the site supplies the absolute travel limits of its stage

operator_required.name: beam_position
operator_required.reason: no text file of the clone states the range or the unit of the beam position (x, y); the AutoScript configuration sets it, so the site supplies the beam-shift limits of its column

safe_state.description: RPC link closed through TEMClient.close; this client does not command the electron beam, the stage or the column valves
